title: DIALECTALARABICMMLU: Benchmarking Dialectal Capabilities in Arabic and Multilingual Language Models
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for the 'World Religions' domain. The results are aggregated across all 32 domains, so no religion-specific conclusions can be drawn from the reported data.
